verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents a large ecosystem of open-source plugins for AI providers. Models can be used through LiveKit Inference or through plugins that reach a wider range of providers. TTS is explicitly one of the plugin interfaces, and its API key and base URL can be overridden to point at providers that aren't included. Together this supports the story's "plug in multiple TTS providers" path. Missing for 10: named TTS providers or a TTS-specific provider list, any evidence of a browsable voice library or voice selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of swapping TTS providers.
